audits.title: Election Office Operations Audit 2024

findings.title: Missing Voting Machine Pre-Election Testing Documentation
findings.description: Over 150 required pre-election Logic and Accuracy (L&A) testing documents were missing or incomplete for the 2024 general election. Testing certifications could not be verified for 47 voting machines deployed across 12 precincts.
findings.statuteName: PA Election Code - Voting Machine Testing
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive digital tracking system for all L&A testing with mandatory sign-off procedures
findings.managementResponse: Working with vendor to implement electronic certification tracking

findings.title: Ballot Chain of Custody Documentation Gaps
findings.description: Chain of custody logs for mail-in ballots were incomplete for 8 delivery dates during the October 2024 early voting period.
findings.recommendation: Require dual-signature verification for all ballot transfers

findings.title: Inadequate Poll Worker Training Records
findings.description: Training completion records were missing for 23 poll workers who served in the 2024 primary election.

recommendations: Implement electronic L&A testing certification system
Create ballot chain of custody tracking application
Require mandatory training completion verification before poll worker assignment

controllerFlags.requiredAction: Controller review; potential referral to PA Department of State
controllerFlags.legalImplications: Non-compliance with PA Election Code may result in certification challenges
